title: PEETS: Preference-aware Embeddings with Explicit Tree Structure for Auxiliary Product Bundling
abstract: arXiv:2611.20726v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Auxiliary products such as flight protection and flexible-change services are recommended alongside primary travel purchases. This setting creates a granularity ambiguity: SKUs within one product type share semantics but differ in price and coverage, while rejecting one offer does not imply disinterest in the entire type. We present \textbf{PEETS} (\textbf{P}reference-aware \textbf{E}mbeddings with \textbf{E}xplicit \textbf{T}ree \textbf{S}tructure), a training-time framework for auxiliary product bundling. PEETS regularizes an existing click--conversion predictor through two conditional comparisons. Hierarchical Contrastive Loss uses the pair's common ancestor as a reference; Negative Contrastive Loss conditions structural sampling and comparison shifts on logged rejection events. translated_title: PEETS：面向辅助产品捆绑的基于显式树结构的偏好感知嵌入
translated_abstract: 辅助产品（如航班保障和灵活改签服务）是伴随主要旅行购买一同推荐的。这一场景产生了粒度模糊性问题：同一产品类型内的SKU共享语义但在价格和保障范围上有所不同，而拒绝某一个报价并不意味着用户对整个产品类型不感兴趣。我们提出了PEETS（基于显式树结构的偏好感知嵌入），这是一个用于辅助产品捆绑的训练时框架。PEETS通过两个条件比较机制对现有的点击-转化预测器进行正则化：层次对比损失以配对的共同祖先节点作为参考；负对比损失则基于记录的拒绝事件来调节结构采样和比较偏移。两者都在训练期间作用于共享的SKU表示。这将目录相关性与个体偏好监督分离开来，并保持预测...（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PEETS训练框架，通过利用显式树结构的层次对比损失和基于用户拒绝事件的负对比损失来正则化点击-转化预测器，从而解决辅助产品捆绑推荐中的粒度模糊性问题。
en_tdlr: PEETS is a training-time framework that resolves granularity ambiguity in auxiliary product bundling by regularizing click-conversion predictors with hierarchical contrastive loss based on explicit tree structure and negative contrastive loss conditioned on logged rejection events.
